verdict.rationale: Abacum documents scenario planning in which base, bull and bear versions are built off the same base and changing an assumption moves cash along with revenue and hiring. Its models are also documented to include a cash flow statement built from live actuals, so cash is computed per scenario. However, no evidence mentions burn rate, runway or a zero-cash date being calculated or compared across scenarios. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario burn and runway metrics, a zero-cash-date view or comparison across scenarios, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
